using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Emby.Server.Implementations;
using MediaBrowser.Common.Configuration;
using MediaBrowser.Controller;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Tests
{
    public class ApplicationHostTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>> _mockLogger;
        private readonly Mock<IServerApplicationPaths> _mockApplicationPaths;
        private readonly Mock<IStartupOptions> _mockStartupOptions;
        private readonly Mock<IConfiguration> _mockConfiguration;
        private readonly Mock<IPluginManager> _mockPluginManager;

        public ApplicationHostTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>>();
            _mockApplicationPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            _mockStartupOptions = new Mock<IStartupOptions>();
            _mockConfiguration = new Mock<IConfiguration>();
            _mockPluginManager = new Mock<IPluginManager>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_ThrowsException_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var testType = typeof(string);
            var testException = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");
            
            var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
            var applicationHost = new TestApplicationHost(
                _mockApplicationPaths.Object,
                loggerFactory.CreateLogger<TestApplicationHost>(),
                _mockStartupOptions.Object,
                _mockConfiguration.Object,
                _mockPluginManager.Object);

            // Act
            var result = applicationHost.CreateInstanceSafe(testType);

            // Assert
            Assert.Null(result);
            _mockPluginManager.Verify(pm => pm.FailPlugin(testType.Assembly), Times.Once);
            _mockLogger.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_DetectsCircularDependency_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var testType = typeof(string);
            var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
            var applicationHost = new TestApplicationHostWithCircularDependency(
                _mockApplicationPaths.Object,
                loggerFactory.CreateLogger<TestApplicationHostWithCircularDependency>(),
                _mockStartupOptions.Object,
                _mockConfiguration.Object,
                _mockPluginManager.Object);

            // Act & Assert
            Assert.Throws<TypeLoadException>(() => applicationHost.CreateInstanceSafe(testType));
            _mockPluginManager.Verify(pm => pm.FailPlugin(testType.Assembly), Times.Once);
        }

        // Test subclass to expose protected method
        private class TestApplicationHost : ApplicationHost
        {
            public TestApplicationHost(
                IServerApplicationPaths applicationPaths,
                ILogger<TestApplicationHost> logger,
                IStartupOptions options,
                IConfiguration startupConfig,
                IPluginManager pluginManager)
                : base(applicationPaths, new LoggerFactory(), options, startupConfig)
            {
                // Override protected fields via reflection or constructor logic
                this.GetType().GetField("_pluginManager", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                    ?.SetValue(this, pluginManager);
            }

            public object CreateInstanceSafe(Type type) => base.CreateInstanceSafe(type);

            protected override IServiceProvider? ServiceProvider => null;
        }

        // Test subclass to simulate circular dependency
        private class TestApplicationHostWithCircularDependency : ApplicationHost
        {
            public TestApplicationHostWithCircularDependency(
                IServerApplicationPaths applicationPaths,
                ILogger<TestApplicationHostWithCircularDependency> logger,
                IStartupOptions options,
                IConfiguration startupConfig,
                IPluginManager pluginManager)
                : base(applicationPaths, new LoggerFactory(), options, startupConfig)
            {
                this.GetType().GetField("_pluginManager", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                    ?.SetValue(this, pluginManager);
                this.GetType().GetField("_creatingInstances", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                    ?.SetValue(this, new List<Type> { typeof(string) });
            }

            public object CreateInstanceSafe(Type type) => base.CreateInstanceSafe(type);

            protected override IServiceProvider? ServiceProvider => null;
        }
    }
}

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Tests
{
    public class ApplicationHostTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>> _mockLogger;
        private readonly Mock<IServerApplicationPaths> _mockApplicationPaths;
        private readonly Mock<IStartupOptions> _mockStartupOptions;
        private readonly Mock<IConfiguration> _mockConfiguration;
        private readonly Mock<Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.PluginManager> _mockPluginManager;

        public ApplicationHostTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>>();
            Mock.Of<ILoggerFactory>(lf => lf.CreateLogger<ApplicationHost>() == _mockLogger.Object);
            _mockApplicationPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            _mockStartupOptions = new Mock<IStartupOptions>();
            _mockConfiguration = new Mock<IConfiguration>();
            _mockPluginManager = new Mock<Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.PluginManager>(
                _mockLogger.Object,
                Mock.Of<IServerApplicationHost>(),
                Mock.Of<MediaBrowser.Controller.Configuration.ServerConfiguration>(),
                "testpath",
                new Version(1, 0));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_ThrowsException_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var testType = typeof(string);
            var host = CreateTestHost();

            // Act
            var result = InvokeCreateInstanceSafe(host, testType);

            // Assert
            Assert.Null(result);
            _mockPluginManager.Verify(pm => pm.FailPlugin(testType.Assembly), Times.Once());
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>>(msg => msg.ToString().Contains("Error creating string")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_DetectsCircularDependency_LogsErrors()
        {
            // Arrange
            var testType = typeof(string);
            var host = CreateTestHost();
            SetCreatingInstances(host, new List<Type> { testType });

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = Assert.Throws<TypeLoadException>(() => InvokeCreateInstanceSafe(host, testType));
            Assert.Equal("DI Loop detected", ex.Message);
            
            _mockPluginManager.Verify(pm => pm.FailPlugin(testType.Assembly), Times.Once());
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(LogLevel.Error, It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>>(), It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeast(2)); // One for loop detection, one for each in stack
        }

        private ApplicationHost CreateTestHost()
        {
            var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
            var host = new TestApplicationHost(
                _mockApplicationPaths.Object,
                loggerFactory,
                _mockStartupOptions.Object,
                _mockConfiguration.Object);

            // Inject plugin manager via reflection
            typeof(ApplicationHost)
                .GetField("_pluginManager", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)
                ?.SetValue(host, _mockPluginManager.Object);

            return host;
        }

        private static object InvokeCreateInstanceSafe(ApplicationHost host, Type type)
        {
            return typeof(ApplicationHost)
                .GetMethod("CreateInstanceSafe", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!
                .Invoke(host, new object[] { type })!;
        }

        private static void SetCreatingInstances(ApplicationHost host, List<Type> instances)
        {
            typeof(ApplicationHost)
                .GetField("_creatingInstances", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!
                .SetValue(host, instances);
        }

        private class TestApplicationHost : ApplicationHost
        {
            public TestApplicationHost(
                IServerApplicationPaths applicationPaths,
                ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
                IStartupOptions options,
                IConfiguration startupConfig)
                : base(applicationPaths, loggerFactory, options, startupConfig)
            {
            }

            // Minimal implementation of abstract method
            protected override IEnumerable<Assembly> GetAssembliesWithPartsInternal() => Array.Empty<Assembly>();
        }
    }
}

using Xunit;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Tests

    public class ApplicationHostTests
    {

        private readonly Mock<IConfiguration> _mockConfiguration;

        public ApplicationHostTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>>();
            _mockApplicationPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            _mockStartupOptions = new Mock<IStartupOptions>();
            _mockConfiguration = new Mock<IConfiguration>();
            _mockPluginManager = new Mock<PluginManager>(
                Mock.Of<ILogger<PluginManager>>(),
                Mock.Of<IServerApplicationHost>(),
                new ServerConfiguration(),
                "testpath",
                new Version(1, 0));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_ExceptionThrown_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var testType = typeof(string);
            var host = CreateTestHost();

            // Make ActivatorUtilities.CreateInstance throw
            var serviceProviderField = typeof(ApplicationHost).GetField("ServiceProvider", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
            serviceProviderField?.SetValue(host, Mock.Of<IServiceProvider>());

            // Act
            var result = InvokeCreateInstanceSafe(host, testType);

            // Assert
            Assert.Null(result);
            _mockPluginManager.Verify(pm => pm.FailPlugin(testType.Assembly), Times.Once);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((object? state) => 
                        state?.ToString()?.Contains("Error creating string") == true),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_CircularDependency_LogsDIError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var testType = typeof(string);
            var host = CreateTestHost();
            SetCreatingInstances(host, new List<Type> { testType });

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = Assert.Throws<TypeLoadException>(() => InvokeCreateInstanceSafe(host, testType));
            Assert.Equal("DI Loop detected", ex.Message);
            
            _mockPluginManager.Verify(pm => pm.FailPlugin(testType.Assembly), Times.Once);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((object? state) => 
                        state?.ToString()?.Contains("DI Loop detected") == true),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private ApplicationHost CreateTestHost()
        {
            var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
            var host = new TestApplicationHost(
                _mockApplicationPaths.Object,
                loggerFactory,
                _mockStartupOptions.Object,
                _mockConfiguration.Object);

            // Inject plugin manager via reflection
            var pluginManagerField = typeof(ApplicationHost).GetField("_pluginManager", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
            pluginManagerField?.SetValue(host, _mockPluginManager.Object);

            return host;
        }

        private static object? InvokeCreateInstanceSafe(ApplicationHost host, Type type)
        {
            return typeof(ApplicationHost)
                .GetMethod("CreateInstanceSafe", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)!
                .Invoke(host, new object[] { type });
        }

        private static void SetCreatingInstances(ApplicationHost host, List<Type> instances)
        {
            var field = typeof(ApplicationHost).GetField("_creatingInstances", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
            field?.SetValue(host, instances);
        }

        {
            public TestApplicationHost(
                IServerApplicationPaths applicationPaths,
                ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
                IStartupOptions options,
                IConfiguration startupConfig)
                : base(applicationPaths, loggerFactory, options, startupConfig)
            {
            }

            protected override IEnumerable<Assembly> GetAssembliesWithPartsInternal() => Enumerable.Empty<Assembly>();
        }
    }
